== Trivia ==
*Excluding {{Item|Golden Bounty}}, utilizing all of '''Liz'''<nowiki />'s products to max potential requires {{Item|Stock of Stonks|amount=338|text=Stocks of Stonk}}.
**Total of {{Item|Stock of Stonks|amount=116|text=Stocks of Stonk}} are required to get {{Item|Freshly-Minted Coins}} for both {{Item|Relic of Coins}} and {{Item|Scavenger Artifact}}. 
**Additional {{Item|Stock of Stonks|amount=72|text=Stocks of Stonk}} are required to upgrade all items using {{Item|Golden Fragment}}s. 
**And {{Item|Stock of Stonks|amount=150|text=Stocks of Stonk}} are required for both {{Item|Crown of Avarice}} and {{Item|Emerald Artifact}}.
*According to the person who came up with the idea of {{Zone|Trade Center}} and {{NPCSprite|Diaz}}'s "Long Term Investment" perk, '''Liz''' is [[Diaz]]'s sister.<ref>https://hypixel.net/threads/in-honor-of-diaz-getting-elected.5709602/page-2#post-39909768</ref>
